items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: I remember specifically remember hearing Rudy Vallee, and of course Bing Crosby.

ctx.x: At that time I remember hearing the orchestras -- it possibly was people like Rudy Vallee, I remember specifically remember hearing Rudy Vallee, and of course Bing Crosby. And at that time the Mills Brothers were very, very, very important figures in the world of entertainment.
